answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before its trades count, then slash that bond if a bonded counterparty proves the agent double-spent or broke a signed agreement. A newcomer can whisper claims, but earns no trading weight until it builds a track record; splitting one identity into a spiral of aliases does not multiply influence because each alias needs its own locked funds. The ledge for an attacker is therefore capital: faking identities ties up real value, and misconduct risks losing it.
